text.p: Vlaamse LuchttransportMaatschapptj (VLM) a small Antwerp-based airline, has signed a cooperation agreement with Deustche Lufthansa AG, VLM's sales and marketing manager, Herman Vermeiren said.
From July 1, the two airline's will code-share on Fokker 50 flights between Rotterdam and London City, as well as between Monchen-Gladbach and London City.
In addition, the airlines will code-share on flights on the Antwerp-Rotterdam-Munich route from September 1 which is also operated by a Fokker 50, he added.
VLM has a total of seven Fokker 50 aircraft and operates services in Belgium, Germany and the Netherlands.
The four-year-old private airline is controlled by its chairman, Jaap Rosen Jacobsen,.
